core_obligations: Show G is a sheaf (proof lines 1938-1940).
Compute G x_F G -> G x G by the cartesian square and make it representable (proof lines 1940-1949).
Assemble Delta_G as a composition of representable transformations (proof lines 1950-1955).
Transport a surjective etale chart U -> F to a chart U' -> G (proof lines 1956-1961).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an algebraic space F over S and a representable transformation G -> F of functors, the functor G is an algebraic space (source lines 1926-1936). The proof first obtains that G is a sheaf, then computes the diagonal of G through the cartesian square relating G x_F G to F x F, uses representability of the diagonal of a representable transformation and stability under composition to make Delta_G representable, and finally transports a surjective etale chart U -> F to the chart U' = U x_F G -> G.
